notes: The build container's network policy denied direct HTTPS to mujassam.net (proxy CONNECT 403), so pages were read through a web-fetch tool that returns rendered page text. Raw-HTML checks (JSON-LD, html lang/dir, script tags, response headers, status codes of every URL) are therefore marked as hypotheses until `python -m geo audit` runs from a machine with direct access.

findings.title: ABS listed on pricing page but FAQ says only PLA and PETG are offered
findings.evidence: Pricing H3 'ABS-خامة بتستحمل حرارة عالية' at 10.00 EGP/g; FAQ 'ايه هي الخامات المتاحة؟' answers PLA and PETG only.
findings.recommendation: Owner confirms whether ABS is available now; then align FAQ, materials section, pricing and upload form.
findings.verification: Re-fetch both pages; fact materials.offered has one value.

findings.title: Payment methods differ between pages
findings.evidence: Home and guide: InstaPay or Vodafone Cash. Privacy: payment gateways Paymob, Kashier, Stripe. Terms: prepaid only, methods not listed.
findings.recommendation: Owner confirms actual payment methods; update home/guide/privacy consistently (privacy change needs legal review).
findings.verification: All pages list the same methods.

findings.title: Cancellation window conflicts (1 hour vs until printing starts)
findings.evidence: FAQ: cancel within one hour of confirmation. Refund policy: full refund while status is 'بانتظار الطباعة'.
findings.recommendation: Owner decides the real rule; legal/policy review before editing either page.

findings.title: Delivery time wording mixes production and door delivery
findings.evidence: FAQ: usually completed within two working days after payment. Resources: delivery to your door 'within two days'.
findings.recommendation: State production time and Bosta delivery time separately, using real fulfilment data.
findings.verification: Wording consistent and backed by order data.

findings.title: 'Valid today only' 50% discount may be a permanent label
findings.evidence: Pricing H2 'الخصم دا ساري انهارده بس' with 'بيتطبّق تلقائيًا على كل تسعيرة'. Seen once on 2026-10-12; permanence not yet proven.
findings.recommendation: If the discount is ongoing, describe it as an ongoing launch discount with an end date or state the real price. False urgency hurts trust and AI answers may quote a stale 'today only' price.
findings.verification: Daily check job records the banner for 7 consecutive days.

findings.title: Layer height values differ (0.28/0.16 mm vs default 0.2 mm)
findings.evidence: Home form: Fast 0.28 mm / High 0.16 mm. Guide: default 0.2 mm.
findings.recommendation: Align guide with the actual quality presets.

findings.title: Resources page says '3 verified sites' but lists six
findings.evidence: Text '3 موقع مفحوصين' with six H3 sources; Maker World entry has no description.
findings.recommendation: Fix count and add a real description for each source.

findings.title: Opening hours show 18:04 and omit Friday
findings.recommendation: Owner confirms real hours (likely 18:00) and whether Friday is closed; then state it explicitly.

findings.title: 'Companies and makers who worked with us' logos have no supporting evidence
findings.evidence: Heading 'شركات وصُنّاع عملوا معانا' followed by AUC, GUC, Nile University, Cairo University, Fab Lab Egypt, ITI.
findings.recommendation: Keep only organisations with documented work and permission to show their name/logo; add a short case note per organisation if available.
findings.verification: Owner provides evidence; fact trust.worked_with approved.

findings.title: Testimonials have no verifiable source
findings.evidence: Three 5-star testimonials (Menoufia, Qalyubia) with names only.
findings.recommendation: Link to genuine Google/Facebook reviews or keep as testimonials without Review schema.

findings.title: No JSON-LD structured data detected on homepage
findings.evidence: Rendered-text fetch exposed meta/OG tags but no JSON-LD. Raw HTML not available from the build container.
findings.recommendation: After confirming with raw HTML: add Organization + WebSite JSON-LD from approved facts only; LocalBusiness only if the pickup address and hours are confirmed. Draft in docs/schema-draft.jsonld.
findings.verification: python -m geo audit (raw HTML) + Google Rich Results Test.

findings.title: html lang/dir attributes not verifiable from rendered text
findings.evidence: og:locale=ar_EG present; html lang/dir not exposed by the fetch tool.
findings.recommendation: Verify <html lang="ar" dir="rtl"> in raw HTML.

findings.title: robots.txt allows search/surfacing crawlers on public pages
findings.evidence: Default group allows the site and disallows admin, API, auth, orders, checkout, payment, preview paths. OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot are not named, so the allow-all default applies. Crawl-delay 2s for Bingbot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot; Bytespider fully disallowed; Sitemap declared.
findings.recommendation: No change required. Note: robots.txt permission is not indexing, and indexing is not citation. Firewall/CDN behaviour for these bots still needs a raw-access check.
findings.verification: python -m geo audit produces robots matrix; check CDN/WAF logs for bot 403s.

findings.title: Sitemap lastmod values are build timestamps, not page change dates
findings.recommendation: Emit real per-page modification dates so crawlers can trust lastmod.
findings.verification: Re-fetch sitemap after next content change.

findings.title: Privacy, terms and refund pages show no 'last updated' date
findings.recommendation: Add a last-updated date (requires legal/policy approval).

findings.title: Privacy policy says no third-party tracking; installing GA4 or Clarity would contradict it
findings.evidence: Policy names Sentry only and states no third-party tracking cookies or ads. Whether GA4/Clarity tags are currently installed was not verifiable from rendered text.
findings.recommendation: Before enabling GA4/Clarity data collection, update the privacy policy and consider consent (legal review).
findings.verification: Inspect raw HTML for gtag/clarity scripts; policy updated.

findings.title: No in-depth pages for material choice, worked price examples, or real case studies
findings.evidence: Site has 8 sitemap URLs; material guidance is a homepage section + short guide; three price examples on home only.
findings.recommendation: See content briefs in reports/initial/content_briefs.md. Validate demand with Search Console before writing.
findings.verification: GSC queries for materials/pricing; AI visibility baseline.

findings.title: No English page version, while English prompts are part of the target set
findings.evidence: No hreflang alternates or English content observed.
findings.recommendation: Decide (owner) whether an English 'About & pricing' page is worth it; measure English prompt visibility first.

findings.title: Showcase includes licensed characters (Spider-Man, Shaun the Sheep)
findings.evidence: Examples section lists a Spider-Man figure and a sheep figure based on Shaun the Sheep.
findings.recommendation: Prefer original or openly licensed designs in marketing showcases; legal review if unsure.
